cases.title: Positive test
cases.text:
Maha Forseng (WR, Tsunami) tested positive for a banned growth agent under the league's drug-testing program. He says the source was an over-the-counter supplement. His B sample confirmed the result.

The players' union says it is reviewing the test results.

cases.title: Firearm violation
cases.text:
A firearm belonging to Yaping Fukamura (S, Asteroids) was discovered in his locker during a routine check. It was loaded.

The club reported the incident to the league itself.
